sn47.11:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn47.11:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante mahāpuriso hotīti.
sn47.11:2.2: idha sārīputta bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.11:2.3: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato cittaṃ virajjati vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi.
sn47.11:2.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.11:2.7: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ virajjati vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi.
